note: Values Auto and the dev Autofill pick for each lifepath stage, so a generated value reflects the stage that grants it. Original prototype text, not from Captain's Log: the book only gives the 20 general sample values of the Values Matrix (p.90) plus a prompt per stage (Education valueText per option; Career Length valuePrompt: Novice 'inexperience and naivete', Experienced 'chosen freely', Veteran 'years of experience'; Finishing Touches p.129: 'might reflect the career events'). Players still choose from the Values Matrix or write their own on screen. Keyed by setting/condition id, education option id, career length id, and career event id (the final value draws from the character's two events). Draft copy for designer review.

homeworld: The traditions of my people are worth carrying to the stars
I will honor the legacy of those who came before me
Every culture deserves the respect I give my own
busyColony: Pioneers build the future with their own hands
My colony's independence taught me to stand on my own
Pride in my home drives me to excel
isolatedColony: Solitude is where true understanding begins
frontierColony: Stubbornness has kept my people alive
Someone has to stand watch at the edge of the map
starshipOrStarbase: A ship is a home, and its crew a family
I learned to fly before I learned to walk
Every system aboard matters, no matter how small
anotherSpeciesWorld: I belong to two worlds and fully to neither
Seeing my people through other eyes keeps me honest
Home is where you are accepted, not where you were born
utopianParadise: Abundance is a responsibility, not a privilege
Everyone deserves the chance to thrive
cosmopolitan: Our differences are the Galaxy's greatest strength
Every culture has something to teach me
A conversation can bridge any gulf
Strangers are just friends I haven't met yet
rigorousDiscipline: I am capable of more than I believe
Discipline is the foundation of freedom
asceticismAndIntrospection: Know yourself before you judge others
Possessions distract from what truly matters
struggleAndHardship: I fight so others won't have to struggle as I did
occupationOrWar: Never again will I stand by while others suffer

commandTrack: A captain's first duty is to the crew
The hardest decisions are the ones that matter most
operationsTrack: If it's broken, I can fix it
A ship runs on the people nobody notices
sciencesTrack: Every anomaly is a question waiting to be answered
Follow the evidence, wherever it leads
rankAndFile: I enlisted to serve, not to be served
The chain of command exists for a reason
Look after the person beside you
officerTraining: An officer's word is a promise
intelligenceTraining: Trust is a resource; spend it wisely
What is unseen often matters most
militiaAndGuerillas: I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves
Home is worth defending at any cost
honoraryStatus: I must prove I deserve the trust I've been given
My first career still guides my choices
freightAndTransport: A good pilot knows every shortcut
lawEnforcement: Justice must be fair to be justice
politicianOrBureaucrat: Rules exist to protect the vulnerable
scientificOrTechnicalExpert: Innovation means trying what others call impossible
traderOrMerchant: A fair deal benefits both sides
Know your partner and you'll know the deal

novice: I still have so much to learn
Everything out here is new and wonderful
The regulations have an answer for everything
experienced: I've seen enough to know what matters
Balance duty with a life worth living
veteran: I've lost too many friends to take risks lightly
Young officers deserve the guidance I never had
There is no such thing as a routine mission
Patience wins more battles than bravado

shipDestroyed: A ship is only metal; the crew is what matters
deathOfAFriend: Live every day as if it matters
I carry my friend's memory into everything I do
laudedByAnotherCulture: Honor freely given is the greatest gift
negotiatedATreaty: Peace is built one agreement at a time
There is always room at the table
requiredToTakeCommand: When no one else will lead, I will
Command found me before I was ready
encounterWithATrulyAlienBeing: The universe is stranger than we can imagine
seriousInjury: Every day is a second chance
Pain is a teacher, not a master
conflictWithAHostileCulture: Know your enemy, and you may find a friend
mentored: Pass on what you have been given
transporterAccident: Never take the ordinary for granted
Technology is only as safe as its users
dealingWithAPlague: Fear spreads faster than any disease
betrayedIdealsForASuperior: I will never compromise my principles again
calledOutASuperior: Speak the truth, even to power
Rank does not make anyone right
learnedUniqueLanguage: To speak a language is to understand a people
Communication is the first step to friendship
discoveredAnArtifact: The past holds the keys to the future
Some mysteries should be handled with care
specialCommendation: Excellence is a habit, not an act
Recognition belongs to the whole crew
solvedAnEngineeringCrisis: There's always a way out if you know the system
Stay calm and work the problem
breakthroughOrInvention: Today's impossibility is tomorrow's standard procedure
firstContact: Every first meeting shapes the future
Approach the unknown with an open hand
